confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are more reliable than hostel and hotel rates, which vary by district, season and booking channel. Cocktail is estimated at about 5x the beer anchor and wine at about 4.5x, since direct bar and wine-list knowledge is weak. The FX value (0.6955 on 2026-10-15) comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not verify it against the page body, so re-check it on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against large inland Chinese metropolises with lower costs than Beijing or Shanghai, using Sichuan-style dining and budget-lodging price levels typical of a city of this size. Accommodation is weighted toward chain budget hotels and registered guesthouses.
